content: WhatsApp photo mode re-encodes images server-side (~80% quality cut, commonly 200-300KB) and strips most EXIF including capture date; document mode preserves files and metadata. Bots receive the compressed version. Archived media get file dates equal to download time, so use the WhatsApp message timestamp as the canonical date. EXIF orientation must be applied explicitly (sharp rotate / PIL exif_transpose) or images render rotated. whatsapp-web.js has no pre-download metadata API (issue #3435). Sources: metaclean.app, ikarus.sg, wwebjs.dev, sciepublish forensic study.
